prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on what you need (talking-head presenter vs. fast social reels, number of variants, budget, languages, brand controls). Tell me your goals and I’ll recommend the best fit. Meanwhile, here’s a short guide and a few top choices by use case.

Quick questions (pick or answer any):
- Primary platform: Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/TV?
- Ad type: talking-head/presenter, animated explainer, short social clip, product demo, or cinematic?
- Volume: one-off or dozens/hundreds of variants (scale)?
- Budget: free/low, mid (subscription), or premium?
- Must-haves: native languages/localization, real human-like voice, brand kit, analytics, API integration?
- Timeline: minutes, hours, or days?

Top contenders and when to pick them
- Synthesia / HeyGen / Elai.io — Best for talking-head ads using AI presenters (easy localization, corporate style). Use these when you want a virtual spokesperson or multiple-language voiceovers.
- Pictory / Opus Clip / Lumen5 — Best for turning scripts/articles/long videos into short social ads with auto captions and fast edits. Good for repurposing content.
- Canva / InVideo / VEED — Best all-around for fast template-based social ads, simple editing, brand kits and collaboration. Good balance of ease, price, options.
- Runway — Best for creative/generative visual effects, advanced editing, or text-to-video experimentation where you want novel visuals.
- Shakr / VidMob / Celtra — Best for large-scale ad variation and dynamic creative optimization for ad platforms (scale + analytics).
- Promo.com / Storyblok-style tools — Good if you want curated stock footage + licensed music + marketing-focused templates.

How to pick (checklist)
- Output formats/resolutions + platform presets
- Captions and auto-subtitles
- Voice quality and language coverage
- Brand kit (fonts, colors, logo)
- Licensing for stock footage/music
- Team collaboration and review workflow
- API or bulk-creation for scale
- Trial/free tier to test output quality

If you tell me platform, ad type, budget and whether you need localization or scale, I’ll recommend the top 2–3 tools and a quick plan (template, script tips, and runtime) to get your first ad done.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
